source_reference: Zhuang-ABCA-2, unexposed male, measured MERFISH raw matrix
anatomical_proxy: Anterior cingulate cortex ACAd+ACAv as registered anatomical proxy for the source bulk anterior-cingulate dissection; exact surgical boundaries are unavailable
region_selection: division=Isocortex and structure in {ACAd,ACAv}; all ten substructures
bulk_population: Primary GSE297423 eight animals: four PBS controls, four PM2.5 animals, without PFF
effect_mapping: Exact unique Ensembl gene identifier, not a substituted family member or ambiguous gene symbol
default_gene_rule: All measured genes with finite primary inference/shrunk effect and BH<.05, ranked by unrounded primary BH q then exact gene ID; first10
transport: All1122 full cell vectors, float32 little-endian +gzip +base64; every serialized vector independently decoded and compared exactly
positions: Source CCF AP,DV,ML mm plotted ML,AP,-DV; no centered NIfTI RAS transform
uncertainty: Primary unshrunken Wald MLE +/-1.96SE defines alternative group-level scenarios; not per-cell confidence intervals
color_cap: Combined positive reference/scenario order statistic at floor((n-1)*.99), identical to viewer; one shared cap per gene, different genes have separate scales
figure_gene_selection: First3 measured primaryFDR hits by full precision q then EnsemblID: Fosb,Egr3,S1pr1
limitations: One unexposed registered male reference donor is not a control for the humanized-alpha-synuclein experimental animals
Regional bulk effects cannot separate regulation, cell composition, or other source-quality effects; original sex metadata remain unresolved
Uniform regional multiplier cannot identify responding cell types, cell loss, or migration
Only the 1122 physically measured MERFISH panel genes are available; absent genes are not imputed or substituted
Only ACA is modeled, not the entire cortex or brain; no mirrored hemisphere is created
coordinate_tick_locator: Matplotlib MaxNLocator(nbins=3,min_n_ticks=3) on allthree axes; coordinates/counts unchanged
